description: Summarize the current Studio NEO V2 scene: object counts per kind, the 3D map, the character light, the 2D overlays and the full post-processing state. This is the read-back for studio_set_map, studio_set_scene_lighting, studio_set_overlay and studio_set_post_processing. Fails with 'studio not ready' until the Studio scene has finished loading.

map.description: same shape as the studio_set_map result: no, name, loaded, pos, rot, option, light and their *_available flags

lighting.description: same shape as the studio_set_scene_lighting result: color, intensity, rot, shadow

post_processing.description: same shape as the studio_set_post_processing result, all twelve sections filled. Null in the scene summary embedded in the studio_load_scene and studio_save_scene results.
